target.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure
target.body:
## Summary
- split requester wake success from visible message-tool delivery status for subagent completions
- preserve requester/parent wake when required group/channel visible delivery fails to produce message-tool evidence
- persist visible delivery failure details and mark linked detached task delivery as failed instead of delivered

## Why
For group/channel subagent completions, visible replies must still go through the message tool. When that visible delivery fails, the requester/parent wake should remain visible to orchestration instead of becoming a passive `pendingFinalDelivery` dead letter. The visible failure also must not be reported as successful task delivery.

This keeps the safety policy intact while preserving parent continuation and making task delivery accounting honest.

## Contract note
This PR intentionally uses terminal split semantics: requester wake can be credited as delivered while required visible message-tool delivery is recorded as failed. It does not add a fallback direct-send path and does not bypass message-tool policy.

If maintainers prefer required visible output to remain bounded and retryable after requester wake succeeds, I can revise this PR around that contract instead.

## Real behavior proof
**Behavior addressed:** subagent completion delivery where requester/parent handoff runs but the required group/channel visible reply does not produce message-tool evidence.

**Current PR head tested:** `c58c79aeb8786c375d179c516e9599f9492aae56`

**Real environment tested:** local OpenClaw source checkout on this clean PR branch, using exact-head source regression tests for the patched subagent delivery, lifecycle cleanup, detached-task delivery accounting, and SQLite registry restore behavior.

**Exact steps or commands run after this patch:**

```bash
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.ts src/agents/subagent-announce-dispatch.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.types.ts
git diff --check
```

**Evidence after fix:**

```text
Vitest: 6 files passed / 418 tests passed
tsgo core: passed
tsgo core test: passed
oxfmt touched files: passed
git diff --check: passed
```

**Observed result after fix:** focused exact-head coverage verifies that requester wake is recorded as delivered, required visible delivery is marked failed, visible-delivery error metadata is persisted, pending delivery is cleared during cleanup, linked detached task delivery status is set to failed, cleanup replay preserves restored terminal failed delivery, and SQLite restore preserves failed status plus requester-wake/visible-failure metadata.

**What was not tested:** this proof did not send a live Slack/Discord message to an external channel. It intentionally uses exact-head local source regression coverage for the requester wake, visible failure, task-delivery status, cleanup replay, and SQLite restore paths without posting to a real workspace.

## Tests
- `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts` — 6 files / 418 tests passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1` on changed files — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

## Notes
- This clean rewrite drops the release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` change and unrelated CI/script commits from the previous branch state.
- Scope stays narrow: no retry framework, no fallback direct-send behavior, no governed-execution semantics.
